reason: Fruit of two follicles: follicle count 2 within the fruit. 'Fused at the base' does not change the count.

fix: 'glaucous' means a waxy bloom on the surface, not the colour green. Map it to PATO glaucous, never to colour = green.
reason: The stem is more or less glaucous. That is a bloom on the surface, not a green colour.
Second glume and sterile lemma each have 5 nerves. A count of 5 veins in the lemma is true for the sterile lemma. The glume is not covered, but nothing false is said.
Petiole (and rachis) adaxially grooved. Leaving out the adaxial side makes the statement less precise but not false.
Leaflet blades are abaxially tomentose. The lower epidermis of the leaflet is part of the leaf's lower epidermis. The colour (yellow) belongs to a separate annotation.

fix: 'unequal-sided at base' / 'asymmetric at base': the quality belongs to the base of the blade. Use the lamina base as the part, as is already done for 'basally'.
reason: Only the base of the blade is said to be unequal-sided, not the whole leaf.

fix: In flowering-plant floras (e.g. Flora Malesiana Meliaceae), 'costae N on each side' means the side veins. PO costa (PO_0030072) is the midrib of a moss leaf and must not be used for vascular plants.
reason: The costae are counted 6–8 on each side of the midrib, so they are the side veins of the leaflet. The count and the each-side slot are right.

target: vascular bundle (PO_0005020) with bearer_container fruit valve (PO_0000033)
fix: 'valves' after a fruit (siliqua, capsule, legume) are fruit valves. A vein on them is not a leaf midrib.
reason: The mid-vein is on the valves of the siliqua, not on a leaf.
Sepals not keeled: the negation is scoped right and the part is right.

target: brown (FLOPO_0988003) | yellow (FLOPO_0988004) | white | liver-coloured (dark reddish brown), as one set of alternatives
fix: A comma list ending in 'or' ('brownish, yellowish, whitish or liver-coloured') is one set of alternatives. Do not split off its first member as if it were a plain statement.
reason: The bark is one of four colours. Saying only brown makes the statement stronger than the flora's.

fix: 'base X to Y' after a blade: the range of shapes belongs to the lamina base. The pipeline already saw 'base' in from_text but kept the blade as the part.
reason: Attenuate-to-truncate describes the base of the blade, not the shape of the whole blade.
Calyx lobes strigose outside: the outer (abaxial) surface of the sepal is strigose.
Side veins (14–)16–25 on each side of the midvein, in the blade. The landmark and the outlying minimum are recorded.

fix: In Apiaceae, 'Sheaths' after 'petiole ... sheathing at base' are leaf sheaths, not stipules.
reason: The 0.5–1 cm sheath is the sheathing base of the petiole of the basal leaves.
In Rubiaceae the 'calyx-tube' is fused to the ovary and the limb is the free calyx. Saying the calyx is ± scarious, with 'approximately', matches the flora.
Ovary ovoid. PATO_0001891 lists 'ovoid' as a synonym. A separate ovoid term is still waiting on PATO change request #627.
Each inflorescence has 15–80 flowers.
Spiciform racemes: the inflorescence is spike-like.

target: place: abaxial side of the leaf (lower surface)
fix: 'raised beneath' / 'prominent below': the 'beneath' is the place slot and must be kept. Veins raised beneath are often impressed above.
reason: Venation is raised only on the lower surface, and the upper surface is rugose. 'Veins raised' with no place can be false.

target: place: base of the corolla (basal star)
fix: 'with [colour] basal star / eye / spot / tip / margins' is the colour of one region of the part. Fill the place slot or use that region as the part, never the colour of the whole part.
reason: The corolla is yellow. Only a basal star is greenish, so 'corolla green' is false.

fix: 'X or Y at base': 'at base' applies to both alternatives. Use the base as the part, as for 'basally'.
reason: Only the base of the culm is light brown or purplish-tinged.

fix: Side veins counted 'per side' are counted within the blade (landmark: the primary vein). A vascular bundle does not contain them.
reason: The count and the extremes are right, but the container is the vascular bundle instead of the blade.

fix: In a phrase list after 'lateral veins N pairs, ..., abaxially prominent', the qualities belong to the veins until a new part is named.
reason: The lateral veins are abaxially prominent, not the blade.
Cymes are very numerous: inflorescences present, count word 'many'.

target: place: apex and margin of the bract
fix: Same as A03409: 'with [colour] tip and margins' gives the colour of the tip and margins only.
reason: Only the tip and margins of the bracts are yellowish, so 'bract yellow' is false.
Stems basally glabrous: the stem base is glabrous.
Glabrate on the upper surface of the blade: the upper surface is glabrescent.

target: place: on the vein (primary vein, PO_0025413) of the lower surface
fix: 'lower surface on the vein X, in the areoles Y': the 'on the vein' place must be kept. The part is the vein on that surface, not the whole surface.
reason: Only the vein is yellow-tomentose to -hirtellous. Between the veins the surface is arachnoid-tomentose or almost bare.
Annual or perennial life span, as alternatives.
Style shorter than the ovary: decreased length compared with the ovary.
